quarterly_data.quarter: AMD press release: AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN Expand Saudi Arabia's AI (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN (a PIF company) announced that AMD Instinct MI355X GPU-based AI infrastructure, with AMD EPYC CPUs and Cisco Silicon One-based AI networking (Cisco N9000 Series platform and Cisco 800G optics), is now live in production in Saudi Arabia and serving HUMAIN customers, enabling HUMAIN to offer GPU-as-a-service from model training to inferencing. CEO Lisa Su: 'Bringing AMD Instinct systems online in Saudi Arabia is an important milestone in our work with HUMAIN.'
quarterly_data.figure: MI355X production deployment live in Saudi Arabia

players.product: Helios rack-scale platform (Instinct + EPYC, Infinity Fabric / UALink scale-up)

quarterly_data.quarter: AMD press release: AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN Expand Saudi Arabia's AI (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Next phase of the previously announced AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN joint venture: the companies plan to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure powered by AMD Instinct MI400 Series GPUs, AMD EPYC CPUs and AMD ROCm software, together with Cisco networking and critical infrastructure. Deployment is planned to begin in 2027, with capacity expected to start coming online in the second half of the year. Driven by strong customer demand, the joint venture remains on track to deploy up to 1 GW of AI infrastructure by 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 250 MW (Instinct MI400 Series) from 2027, capacity online in the second half of 2027; JV on track for up to 1 GW by 2030
